limitations: Six scored quarters; outcomes viewed before protocol, no blind holdout
Historical supply/rate sources are current vintages
Coinbase gross USDC income is a proxy, not an exact payable to Circle
Partner-dependent methods are unavailable before Coinbase reports
The platform rule assumes unchanged Circle share and residual economics; current Circle platform mix is not known
Underlying RLDC and actual-revenue cost-only results use actual revenue for scoring/diagnostics, not as forecast inputs
Approximately 180m ARC Q3 timing is a conditional allocation of pre-release annual guidance, not a verified quarter recognition amount
No model is validated solely by lowest error in six observations
